key_insight: AdaRoll-GRPO improves LLM post-training by adapting rollout allocation to question difficulty while keeping the total rollout budget fixed.
engineering_relevance: An offline-computed allocation policy can improve sampling efficiency without adding online policy-optimization overhead during GRPO training.
method: Formulate difficulty-aware rollout allocation as a sequential decision-making problem.
Use a Bayes-adaptive MDP to compute an adaptive allocation policy offline.
Apply the policy during GRPO training under the same total rollout budget as standard GRPO.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports consistent improvements over GRPO across multiple reasoning datasets and LLM architectures, but provides no numerical effect sizes.
watch_item: Offline policy-computation costs and robustness to shifts in question difficulty are not quantified in the abstract.
paper_title: Bayes-Adaptive MDPs for Rollout Allocation to Enhance GRPO Training
